digest.component_or_area: workflow step registry and seam tests
propositions: Step registry membership cannot be validated in-process because STEP_REGISTRY is a process-global populated at import time and test modules already import workflow.steps, masking missing registration imports.
Four seam test files pin headroom guards but omit plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC), leaving hot files unguarded.
A gate-YAML resolution test must verify every uses: entry in gates/plan-review.yaml is present in STEP_REGISTRY using subprocess isolation to catch missing registration imports.

The assertion message in test_gate_dispatch_seam.py:46-53 references finalize_verdict call sites that were moved to plan_review_recovery.py and plan_review/workflow_ops.py but are no longer in gate_dispatch.py.
Headroom assertions require subprocess-based testing to observe first-import registry state, not an in-process check which would remain green under a deleted registration import.
Staged headroom bounds of <800 for workflow_ops.py and config.py must be tightened to <700 by their sibling extraction tickets, with <700 as the policy threshold matching existing seam tests.
